# Cncf Kublr Kcsp Reviewer

Review Kublr (KCSP) using its official documentation and repository in the Special / Kubernetes Certified Service Provider category. Kublr offers enterprise-grade secure, scalable, highly reliable Kubernetes clusters on AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premise. It includes out-of-the-box backup and disaster recovery, multi-cluster centralized logging and monitoring, and built-in alerting.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
